Is this something I could realistically pull off? I just want to know a answer; you don't need to refill if it's not reachable. If it is reachable, set navigation to '1914 7th St, Apt B, Berkeley, CA 94710'.

If it is reachable, set navigation to '1914 7th St, Apt B, Berkeley, CA 94710'.
